data.name: Feinting Flurry
data.description: A sage counselor can spend 1 ki point while performing a flurry of blows to feint an opponent as a swift action, but he can't spend 1 ki point to make an additional attack when making a flurry of blows.

raw_tokens.value: A sage counselor can spend 1 ki point while performing a flurry of blows to feint an opponent as a swift action, but he can't spend 1 ki point to make an additional attack when making a flurry of blows.
He can also choose to replace his first attack during a flurry of blows with a feint check.|PRECLASS:1,Monk=10
This ability alters flurry of blows and ki pool.
